A '''river''' was located on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]]. The [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket Wystri Warrick]] once battled a [[hanadak]] in the river, and Warrick was knocked unconscious and washed up on the river's banks, where he was discovered by a group of [[mimph]]s, who took them to their nearby [[Mimph village|village]]. When the hanadak came to the village and began destroying it, Warrick managed to lead the hanadak to the river, where it fell down a waterfall.
